Course guide

Not sure where to start, or a course isn't quite right for you? Pick by what you want to get better at:

  • Reading ECGs and heart rhythms: ECG Interpretation Essentials (Beginner, 6 hours)
  • Emergencies and resuscitation: Basic Life Support Refresher (All levels, 3 hours)
  • Medicines and safe prescribing: Clinical Pharmacology Basics (Intermediate, 8 hours)
  • Research and publishing: Medical Research Writing (Advanced, 5 hours)

All courses are self-paced video lessons with a short quiz and a certificate on completion, with lifetime access.

ECG Interpretation Essentials

Beginner · 6 hours · 12 lessons · ₹1,499 · certificate included

Topic: Reading ECGs and heart rhythms

Read rhythm strips with confidence: rate, rhythm, axis, intervals and the ten patterns you will meet most.

Who it's for: Nursing staff, junior doctors, paramedics and students who see ECGs on shift but don't yet read them confidently.

You will learn: Systematic 7-step ECG read; Recognise common arrhythmias; Spot STEMI patterns early.

Not the right fit? Try instead:

  • Basic Life Support Refresher: You want hands-on emergency skills rather than interpretation.
  • Clinical Pharmacology Basics: You already read ECGs and want to understand the cardiac drugs behind them.

View course page

Basic Life Support Refresher

All levels · 3 hours · 8 lessons · ₹799 · certificate included

Topic: Emergencies and resuscitation

Current adult, child and infant BLS sequences, team roles and high-quality CPR metrics.

Who it's for: Any healthcare worker who needs to refresh resuscitation skills, from students to senior staff.

You will learn: High-quality CPR metrics; AED use; Team-based resuscitation.

Not the right fit? Try instead:

  • ECG Interpretation Essentials: You already know BLS well and want the next step: recognising dangerous rhythms.
  • Clinical Pharmacology Basics: You want ward knowledge rather than emergency skills.

View course page

Clinical Pharmacology Basics

Intermediate · 8 hours · 16 lessons · ₹1,999 · certificate included

Topic: Medicines and safe prescribing

Pharmacokinetics, dosing in renal and hepatic impairment, and the interactions that matter on the ward.

Who it's for: Nurses, pharmacists and doctors who prescribe, check or give medicines on the ward.

You will learn: PK/PD fundamentals; Dose adjustment; High-risk interactions.

Not the right fit? Try instead:

  • Basic Life Support Refresher: You want a short, practical course you can finish in one sitting.
  • Medical Research Writing: You're more interested in evidence and publishing than day-to-day prescribing.

View course page

Medical Research Writing

Advanced · 5 hours · 10 lessons · ₹1,299 · certificate included

Topic: Research and publishing

Structure, write and submit a clinical paper: IMRaD, reporting guidelines and responding to reviewers.

Who it's for: Clinicians and postgraduate students planning to write up a case, audit or study for publication.

You will learn: IMRaD structure; Reporting checklists; Reviewer responses.

Not the right fit? Try instead:

  • Clinical Pharmacology Basics: You want clinical knowledge you can use on shift rather than writing skills.
  • ECG Interpretation Essentials: You want a beginner-friendly clinical skill with quick wins.
